'''June 2002 Brookfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Brookfield, IL on 15 June 2002. [[Al Schaefer]] won it. It is known from Al Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3747">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-16-chicagoland-il-june-mega-tourny-reportd3747/ chicagoland-il-june-mega-tourny-report], DeckTech (Al "MoTU" Schaefer, 16 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-16-chicagoland-il-june-mega-tourny-reportd3747/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 June 2002
* '''Site:''' Brookfield, IL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Players:''' 4
* '''Winner:''' [[Al Schaefer]]
